policy_presence.summary: PSL's 2026-27 scolarité regulation and June 2026 doctoral charter contain AI provisions; scope limited to PSL-operated programmes and doctorates.

coursework.summary: AI only where the instructor authorises it in PSL-operated programmes; member institutions have their own rules.

exams.summary: No general exam AI rule found in reviewed sources.

ai_disclosure.summary: Authorised AI use must be disclosed; doctoral declaration mandatory.

privacy_data_entry.summary: Unit/library rules against sensitive and personal data; no PSL-wide rule found.

academic_integrity.summary: Undisclosed AI use treated as plagiarism; disciplinary procedure possible.

named_ai_services.summary: ChatGPT cited only as an example; no named service is required or provided.

teaching_guidance.summary: No PSL-wide teaching guidance reviewed; CIENS charter is unit-level.

research_guidance.summary: Doctoral AI use allowed if transparent and declared; library recommendations at Dauphine-PSL.

security_procurement.summary: No AI procurement or security review rule found in reviewed sources.
